newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads two for murder, drugs charges.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads two for murder, drugs charges.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Sunday beheaded an Egyptian man for murder and a Pakistani man for smuggling heroin into the kingdom, an interior ministry statement carried by Saudi state-run television said.
The statement said the Egyptian murdered a compatriot by hitting him over the head with a metal rod. He was beheaded in the northwestern holy city of Medina.
The Pakistani was beheaded in the west coast province of Jeddah.
The executions by the sword raised to 66 the number of people executed in the conservative Islamic kingdom this year.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
